import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Standardize Category labels to the allowed set
    allowed = {"Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"}
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Map common misspellings to the correct category
    mapping = {"Furnture": "Furniture", "Office Supplies": "Office Supplies"}
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(mapping)
    # Keep only rows with a valid Category after standardization
    df = df[df['Category'].isin(allowed)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count orders (rows) per Category
    counts = df.groupby('Category').size().to_dict()
    result = {k: int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
    return result
